anthracnose.symptoms: Dark brown to black angular spots on leaves, blossom blight, tear-stain black lesions on maturing fruit.

organic_measures.name: Bordeaux Mixture 1% / Copper Spray
organic_measures.method: Spray 1% Bordeaux mixture or copper oxychloride (3 g/L) before panicle emergence and fruit set.
organic_measures.frequency: Every 14 days during flowering and rainy period

chemical_measures.name: Azoxystrobin 23% SC or Carbendazim 50% WP
chemical_measures.safety_precautions: Observe 14-day pre-harvest interval for fruit safety.

prevention_measures: Prune dead twigs and crisscross branches after fruit harvest.
Perform hot water treatment of harvested fruits (52°C for 5 mins).
sources: ICAR - Central Institute for Subtropical Horticulture (CISH) Mango Guide

bacterial_canker.symptoms: Water-soaked angular spots on leaves turning dark brown with chlorotic halos; star-shaped cracks oozing gum on fruits.

organic_measures.name: Copper Hydroxide Spray
organic_measures.method: Apply copper hydroxide (2.5 g/L) with sticker-spreader.

chemical_measures.name: Streptocycline + Copper Oxychloride
chemical_measures.dosage: 0.1 g + 2.5 g per liter of water
chemical_measures.safety_precautions: Wear PPE. Apply during early morning.

prevention_measures: Collect and burn fallen leaves and cankered twigs.
Plant windbreak trees around orchard borders.

cutting_weevil.symptoms: Newly emerged pinkish tender leaves cut off sharply near the base as if clipped with scissors.

organic_measures.name: Neem Seed Kernel Extract (NSKE 5%)
organic_measures.method: Spray NSKE 5% or Azadirachtin 10,000 ppm (3 ml/L) on new leaf flushes.

chemical_measures.name: Quinalphos 25% EC or Lambda-cyhalothrin 5% EC
chemical_measures.safety_precautions: Spray only when fresh flush is being attacked.

prevention_measures: Rake and destroy fallen cut leaves under canopy containing weevil eggs.
Plough orchard soil under basin to expose pupae.

die_back.symptoms: Dying of twigs from top downwards, brown discolored wood inside stems, leaf scorching and leaf drop.

organic_measures.name: Pruning & Copper Paste Application
organic_measures.method: Prune affected twigs 7-10 cm below the dead wood margin. Paste cut ends with 10% Bordeaux paste or copper oxychloride paste.

prevention_measures: Avoid stem injuries during pruning or harvesting.

gall_midge.symptoms: Conical or wart-like galls on leaf blades, causing leaf deformation and premature drop.

organic_measures.name: Neem Oil & Basin Raking
organic_measures.method: Rake tree basin soil. Spray Neem oil (5 ml/L) on lower canopy during midge emergence.

chemical_measures.name: Dimethoate 30% EC or Imidacloprid 17.8% SL
chemical_measures.safety_precautions: Do not spray during flowering to protect pollinators.

prevention_measures: Expose soil pupae by deep basin tilling in summer.

powdery_mildew.symptoms: White powdery fungal coating on panicles, leaves, and young fruits; causing flower drop and fruit shedding.

organic_measures.name: Wettable Sulfur 80% WP
organic_measures.method: Spray wettable sulfur (3 g/L) or potassium bicarbonate (4 g/L).

chemical_measures.name: Hexaconazole 5% EC or Myclobutanil 10% WP
chemical_measures.safety_precautions: Avoid spraying when temperatures exceed 35°C to prevent phytotoxicity.

prevention_measures: Monitor weather during panicle development (cloudy/cool weather favors mildew).

sooty_mould.symptoms: Black velvet-like superficial fungal layer covering leaf upper surfaces, stems, and fruits fed on insect honeydew.

organic_measures.name: Starch Wash & Sucking Pest Control
organic_measures.method: Spray 2% boiling starch solution (cool before spraying). As starch dries, it flakes off the black mold layer. Spray neem oil (5 ml/L) to kill hoppers/scale insects.

chemical_measures.name: Thiamethoxam 25% WG (Control Honeydew Insects)
chemical_measures.safety_precautions: Target the underlying sap-sucking insects (hoppers, mealybugs) rather than just the mold.

prevention_measures: Control mango leafhoppers, scale insects, and mealybugs early.

mango_healthy.symptoms: Lush dark green leathery leaves, clean bark, disease-free panicles and fruit clusters.

organic_measures.name: Annual Manuring & Micronutrient Spray
organic_measures.method: Apply 50 kg FYM + 1 kg Neem cake per mature tree. Spray 0.5% zinc sulphate + 0.2% boric acid during flush.
